top_strength: Frank patiently clarified exactly what "packing" means for a large two-floor commercial move (roughly 4,000 sqft downstairs plus ~2,500-3,000 sqft upstairs) and, recognizing the square footage made phone-only estimating unreliable, immediately routed the customer to a photo/video upload link so the estimate could be accurate.
coaching_note: Frank never used the customer's name (the account was under "Young", contact email started with "Payton") anywhere in the call despite having it from the lookup — using it even once or twice would have built rapport on a lead this size, and he also skipped any agenda-style framing at the open (no "here's what we'll cover" / "sound good?").
phone_presence_notes: Frank was patient and helpful walking through the packing definition and next steps, and closed with a clear timeline commitment ("today, tomorrow, the latest"), but leaned on repetitive filler ("gotcha, gotcha," "got it, got it, got it") instead of varied warmth and never used the customer's name.
